Chapters:

00:00 - Introduction
00:23 - Whats the need for Service Discovery
03:56 - What is Service Discovery (Eureka Server and Client)
08:18 - Set up of Eureka Server
12:27 - Set up of Eureka Client
16:11 - How Api invocation works with Eureka Client & Server architecture
21:17 - Important Interview questions
22:10 - Question1, How Eureka server knows whether client is up or not?
29:46 - Question2, How Eureka server stores the data
31:07 - Question3, what if Eureka Server is down, is it a Single point failure?
36:41 - Question4, Does for every API call, client need to call Eureka Server?
